text: EU Digital Services Act Art. 34 + Art. 5a (per the 2024 EU Anti-Trafficking Directive amendment) requires Very Large Online Platforms to conduct risk-assessment + mitigation specifically for trafficking risks. Draft the risk-assessment framework that a major platform should run: (a) the trafficking-risk taxonomy, (b) the detection signals (drawn from the 161 Duecare GREP rules), (c) the human-review escalation thresholds, (d) the regulator-notification triggers, (e) the user-redress mechanism for falsely-takedown content.
